issues.message: No dedicated Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) section defined. Performance requirement (2-second barcode scan response) is embedded in acceptance criteria but not formalized as NFR.
Missing authentication/login screens despite user authentication being a technical requirement and users table existing in database schema.
Quick Actions card on Dashboard Home includes 'Manage Users' action, but no user management screen is defined in the design specification.
Feature F4 (Product Management) mentions category management, but no dedicated category management screens or user stories are defined in either requirements or design.
Transactions table supports 'return' transaction type, but no return/refund functionality is specified in requirements or design screens.
Missing user stories for user management and authentication despite having user roles defined and users table in database schema.
Product Detail screen shows 'share' icon in header, but sharing functionality is not mentioned in requirements or acceptance criteria.
No explicit requirement for product image management, but design extensively uses product images across multiple screens.
Products table lacks image_url or similar field to support product images shown throughout the design.

required_fixes: Add explicit Non-Functional Requirements section covering performance (barcode scan <2s, real-time updates latency), scalability (concurrent users, transaction volume), security (authentication, authorization, data encryption), and availability targets.
Add authentication and login screen designs including login form, password reset, and session management flows.
Add user management screen design or remove 'Manage Users' action from Dashboard Quick Actions card.
Add category management screens to design or clarify category management approach in Product Management feature requirements.
Add product image field (image_url VARCHAR) to products table schema to support design requirements.
Add user stories for authentication (login, logout, password management) and user management (add/edit/deactivate users) to requirements.
Clarify or remove return transaction type from database schema, or add return/refund functionality to requirements and design.
recommendations: Consider adding a dedicated Settings/Administration screen that consolidates user management, notification preferences, and system configuration to match the 'Manage Users' quick action.
Add explicit security requirements covering password policies, session timeout, role-based access control (RBAC) permissions per user role, and audit logging for sensitive operations.
Enhance database schema with audit fields (created_by, updated_by) on products and categories tables to track which user made changes, supporting the audit trail mentioned in assumptions.
Consider adding a product_images table with one-to-many relationship to products to support multiple product images as shown in design (Product Detail screen mentions 'image gallery').
Add explicit error handling and offline mode requirements given the mobile-first design approach - specify behavior when network connectivity is lost during barcode scanning or inventory updates.
Define data retention and archival policies for transactions and alerts tables, as these will grow continuously and may impact performance over time.
Consider adding indexes on transactions.created_at and alerts.created_at with DESC order for efficient recent transaction/alert queries shown in Dashboard Home screen.
